name: ShellSense
description:
Small everyday tools for GNOME Shell, each with its own on/off switch:

* Internet speed meter in the top bar
* Clipboard history with search and paste
* Color picker (Alt+P) that copies hex or rgb
* Caffeine: keep the screen on and prevent suspend
* Alphabetical app grid and two-line app names
* Hide the Activities button

Clipboard access: the clipboard history tool reads every text you copy and keeps it in memory only (never written to disk or sent anywhere); entries marked secret by password managers are skipped. It keeps recording while the screen is locked so the history survives locking. Its shortcut is not set by default; choose one in the preferences. The color picker writes the picked color to the clipboard.
